title: CLQT: A Closed-Loop, Cost-Aware, Strategy-Consistent Benchmark for Diagnostic Evaluation of LLM Portfolio-Management Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.29771v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly cast as autonomous portfolio managers, yet the dominant evaluation idiom, a leaderboard of returns over a fixed window, certifies neither the soundness of an agent's process nor the durability of its edge: one period's return is dominated by the market path, and apparent alpha can dissolve once look-ahead bias and trading costs are controlled. We introduce CLQT, a closed-loop benchmark that reframes LLM trading evaluation as diagnosis rather than ranking. CLQT enforces point-in-time data access through a hard TimeGate, models institutional transaction and financing costs, scores strategy consistency across rounds, and seals every gather-analyze-decide-execute-reflect cycle into a recompute-verifiable audit chain; the same model runs as a constrained investment committee or a single autonomous orchestrator, making scaffolding an experimental variable. translated_title: CLQT：一个用于LLM投资组合管理代理诊断性评估的闭环、成本感知、策略一致的基准测试
translated_abstract: LLM代理日益被用作自主投资组合管理者，然而主流的评估方式——固定窗口内的收益率排行榜——既无法证明代理流程的合理性，也无法证明其优势的持久性：单期收益主要由市场路径决定，且一旦控制了前瞻偏差和交易成本，表面的alpha可能消失。我们提出CLQT，一个将LLM交易评估重新界定为诊断而非排名的闭环基准。CLQT通过严格的TimeGate强制执行时点数据访问，建模机构级交易与融资成本，对跨轮次的策略一致性进行评分，并将每个“收集-分析-决策-执行-反思”周期封存到可重新计算验证的审计链中；同一模型既可作为受约束的投资委员会运行，也可作为单一自主协调器运行，从而将架构框架本身作为实验变量。基于审计轨迹，CLQT计算五轴能力指标……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: CLQT提出一个闭环诊断式基准测试，通过时点数据门控、机构级交易成本建模、跨轮策略一致性评分和可验证审计链，将LLM投资组合管理的评估从简单收益排名转变为对代理真实能力与流程稳健性的系统诊断。
en_tdlr: CLQT introduces a closed-loop benchmark that reframes LLM portfolio-management evaluation from return-based ranking to diagnostic assessment, using point-in-time data gating, realistic transaction cost modeling, cross-round strategy consistency scoring, and recompute-verifiable audit chains to rigorously evaluate the true capabilities of LLM trading agents.
